svg.title: Terrain classification bands
svg.desc: A single axis of floor-height change, divided into four labelled regions. Below minus 60 mm is a cliff. From minus 60 to plus 35 mm is flat, which is where door sills fall. From 35 to 150 mm is a climbable riser, which is deliberately not treated as an obstacle. Above 150 mm is blocked.

text.font-family: Saira Condensed, IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW A HEIGHT CHANGE IS CLASSIFIED

text.font-family: Saira Condensed, IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: One axis, four outcomes. Position carries the meaning; colour and label reinforce it.
